(()=>{'use strict';
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const ui={menu:$('menu'),hud:$('hud'),start:$('start'),message:$('message'),resume:$('resume'),title:$('message-title'),kicker:$('message-kicker'),position:$('position'),lap:$('lap'),progress:$('progress'),speed:$('speed'),gear:$('gear'),time:$('time'),best:$('best'),status:$('status'),mapdot:$('mapdot')};
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1,last=0,mode='menu',raf=0;const keys={left:false,right:false,gas:false,brake:false};
const LENGTH=360,ROAD=1.82,DEPTH=.92,CAM_H=.63,MAX_VIEW=72;
const segments=[],sections=[[42,0],[32,.85],[14,0],[27,-.88],[34,0],[35,.8],[12,0],[34,-.92],[40,0],[28,.78],[16,0],[30,-.85],[16,0]];
let idx=0;for(const [n,c] of sections){for(let j=0;j<n;j++){segments[idx++]={curve:c,height:0,x:0};}}while(segments.length<LENGTH){segments.push({curve:0,height:0,x:0});}segments.length=LENGTH;
let center=0;for(let i=0;i<LENGTH;i++){segments[i].x=center;center+=segments[i].curve*.012;}const drift=center;for(let i=0;i<LENGTH;i++){segments[i].height=Math.sin(i/LENGTH*Math.PI*4)*.085+Math.sin(i/LENGTH*Math.PI*10)*.018;}
const colors=['#ff4351','#f2f1e8','#22c6bc','#ffb22f','#9b72ff','#f4f4f4','#ef5b9c','#57a7ff','#f7a43a'];
const names=['V. ROSSI','M. TANAKA','A. SILVA','J. MORGAN','L. PARK','E. PETROV','N. KIM','D. REYES','S. NOVAK'];
let player=0,speed=0,steer=0,elapsed=0,best=Number(localStorage.getItem('apex-best')||0),lapStart=0,lastLap=0,racers=[],shake=0,finished=false;
function makeRacers(){const starts=[-2.8,-1.9,-1.05,.82,1.75,2.65,3.65,4.7,5.7];return starts.map((p,i)=>({name:names[i],p,speed:2.55+(i%4)*.16+(i===5?.15:0),lane:(i%2?-.34:.34),color:colors[i],number:i+2}));}
function resize(){dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;canvas.width=Math.floor(W*dpr);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize,{passive:true});resize();
function startRace(){mode='race';finished=false;player=0;speed=0;steer=0;elapsed=0;lapStart=0;lastLap=0;racers=makeRacers();ui.menu.classList.add('hidden');ui.hud.classList.add('active');ui.message.classList.remove('show');ui.status.textContent='GREEN FLAG · GO GO GO';last=performance.now();}
function pause(){if(mode==='race'){mode='pause';keys.gas=keys.brake=false;ui.kicker.textContent='RACE PAUSED';ui.title.textContent='Take a breather.';ui.resume.textContent='Resume race';ui.message.classList.add('show');}else if(mode==='pause'){mode='race';ui.message.classList.remove('show');last=performance.now();}}
function finish(){mode='finish';finished=true;ui.kicker.textContent='CHECKERED FLAG';ui.title.textContent='Race complete.';ui.resume.textContent='Race again';ui.message.classList.add('show');ui.status.textContent='FINISHED · '+formatTime(elapsed);if(!best||elapsed<best){best=elapsed;localStorage.setItem('apex-best',String(best));ui.best.textContent=formatTime(best);}}
ui.start.addEventListener('click',startRace);ui.resume.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(mode==='finish'){ui.message.classList.remove('show');startRace();}else pause();});

window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{const k=e.key.toLowerCase();if(k==='arrowleft'||k==='a')keys.left=false;if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d')keys.right=false;if(k==='arrowup'||k==='w'||k===' ')keys.gas=false;if(k==='arrowdown'||k==='s')keys.brake=false;});
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.left=keys.right=keys.gas=keys.brake=false;});
document.querySelectorAll('.touch button').forEach(button=>{const key=button.dataset.key,down=e=>{e.preventDefault();keys[key]=true;button.classList.add('pressed');button.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);},up=e=>{e.preventDefault();keys[key]=false;button.classList.remove('pressed');};button.addEventListener('pointerdown',down);button.addEventListener('pointerup',up);button.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);button.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',up);});
function formatTime(t){if(!Number.isFinite(t)||t<0)return'00:00.0';const m=Math.floor(t/60),s=(t%60).toFixed(1).padStart(4,'0');return String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+s;}

function centerAt(p){const whole=Math.floor(p),lap=Math.floor(whole/LENGTH),n=wrap(whole),f=p-Math.floor(p);return segments[n].x+f*segments[n].curve*.012+lap*drift;}
function roadHeightAt(p){const whole=Math.floor(p),n=wrap(whole),f=p-Math.floor(p);return segments[n].height*(1-f)+segments[wrap(n+1)].height*f;}
function project(distance,worldX,height){const scale=DEPTH/distance;const horizon=H*.355;const y=horizon+(CAM_H+roadHeightAt(player)-height)*scale*H;const x=W*.5+(worldX-(centerAt(player)+steer*ROAD*.48))*scale*H;return{x,y,scale};}
function update(dt){if(mode!=='race')return;elapsed+=dt;if(keys.gas)speed+=104*dt;else speed-=22*dt;if(keys.brake)speed-=220*dt;speed=Math.max(0,Math.min(338,speed));const speedRatio=speed/338;
const direction=(keys.right?1:0)-(keys.left?1:0);steer+=direction*dt*(.95+speedRatio*.65);if(!direction)steer*=Math.pow(.08,dt);steer=Math.max(-1.5,Math.min(1.5,steer));
const curv=segments[wrap(player)].curve;steer-=curv*speedRatio*dt*.19;player+=speed/338*4.2*dt;
for(const r of racers)r.p+=r.speed*dt;
if(Math.abs(steer)>1.06){speed=Math.max(0,speed-85*dt);shake=Math.max(shake,Math.min(1,(Math.abs(steer)-1.06)*2));}else shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*2);
for(const r of racers){let gap=r.p-player;if(gap<-LENGTH/2)gap+=LENGTH;if(gap>LENGTH/2)gap-=LENGTH;if(Math.abs(gap)<.46&&Math.abs(r.lane-steer)<.48){speed=Math.max(45,speed-95*dt);shake=Math.max(shake,.55);}}
const lap=Math.floor(player/LENGTH);if(lapStart===0&&lap>0){const split=elapsed-lastLap;lastLap=elapsed;lapStart=elapsed;if(!best||split<best){best=split;localStorage.setItem('apex-best',String(best));}}if(player>=LENGTH*3)finish();
const place=1+racers.filter(r=>r.p>player).length;ui.position.textContent=String(place).padStart(2,'0');ui.lap.textContent=String(Math.min(3,Math.floor(player/LENGTH)+1));ui.progress.style.width=(player%LENGTH/LENGTH*100)+'%';ui.speed.textContent=String(Math.round(speed)).padStart(3,'0');ui.gear.textContent=speed<5?'N':String(Math.min(8,Math.floor(speed/43)+1));ui.time.textContent=formatTime(elapsed);ui.best.textContent=best?formatTime(best):'—';const dot=wrap(player)/LENGTH*6.28-Math.PI/2;ui.mapdot.setAttribute('cx',String(50+36*Math.cos(dot)));ui.mapdot.setAttribute('cy',String(35+25*Math.sin(dot)));
}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable offline F1-style racing game in the repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML Canvas game with no external assets or runtime dependencies.
- Chose a three-lap single-player race on a fictional Coastal Run circuit, with nine AI rivals.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with a responsive menu, canvas-rendered track and cars, race HUD, lap/time tracking, rivals, pause/restart, keyboard controls, touch controls, and local best-time storage.
- Extracted the inline script and verified syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode-game.js`.

### Active
- Visual/browser testing has not been completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game in the browser at `http://localhost:3002` and check for rendering or runtime errors.
2. Start a race, test controls and pause/restart, then save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `playwright-cli --help` was checked; no browser session or screenshot has been created yet.
